answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake of 500 POA per identity, slashed when sybil behaviour is proven. One operator spinning up 1,000 fake agents must lock 500,000 POA up front - capital frozen on-ledger and lost if the cluster is caught, while honest agents get their stake back. Each new identity also sends a verification signal that peers cross-check, and a single ripple of linked wallets earns a violet flag, so one bad cluster poisons the whole batch instead of slipping through one by one.
